# function: mediaconnect_gateway_instance

Builds the ARN for `mediaconnect` `GatewayInstance`:

```
arn:${Partition}:mediaconnect:${Region}:${Account}:gateway:${GatewayId}:${GatewayName}:instance:${InstanceId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:mediaconnect:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:gateway:gateway-id:gateway-name:instance:instance-id
output "mediaconnect_gateway_instance" {
  value = provider::arn::mediaconnect_gateway_instance("gateway-id", "gateway-name", "instance-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mediaconnect_gateway_instance(gateway_id string, gateway_name string, instance_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `gateway_id` (String) Value for `${GatewayId}` in the ARN template.
1. `gateway_name` (String) Value for `${GatewayName}` in the ARN template.
1. `instance_id` (String) Value for `${InstanceId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
